probe_provenance: T03 live argv probes; supersedes-as-formal the 2026-09-23 exploratory probe (evidence/host/rootless-host-report.json)

host.nested_container_traits: cap 掩码 0xa80425fb(live /proc/self/status CapBnd); cgroupfs=ro(live mountinfo); 见 identity_observation

findings.name: userns
findings.output_excerpt: unprivileged_userns_clone=1; max_user_namespaces=<unreadable: [Errno 2] No such file or directory: '/proc/sys/kernel/max_user_namespaces'>

findings.name: uid_mappings
findings.output_excerpt: newuidmap: command not found; /etc/subuid=empty; userns 内 uid_map='0          0          1' (single identity); newuidmap/newgidmap: absent
findings.limitation: 仅单 ID 映射;多 container UID/GID 语义不可原生提供,需要 SingleIdCompatibilityPolicy 显式声明

findings.name: cgroup
findings.output_excerpt: touch: cannot touch '/sys/fs/cgroup/.lsbx-delegation-probe': Read-only file system; mount=ro; /proc/self/cgroup: 0::/
findings.limitation: 无 cgroup v2 委托:不可声明任何 memory/pids/cpu/io 硬限额;HardResourceLimits=HOST_UNSUPPORTED 直到管理员委托

findings.name: procfs
findings.limitation: 私有 procfs 挂载 EPERM(嵌套容器继承的 masked /proc + 外层运行时策略);A/B 沙箱共享宿主 /proc 会互相暴露,见 spike P2 安全实验

findings.name: mount
findings.evidence_command: unshare -Urm python3 -c <ctypes mount(2) probe: tmpfs + MS_BIND>
findings.output_excerpt: tmpfs mount+write OK; bind mount content verified
findings.note: tmpfs/bind 挂载在 userns+mountns 内实测可用;namespace 销毁即清理

findings.name: rootfs
findings.output_excerpt: mount: /tmp/lsbx-ov-r_pwktv2/t: wrong fs type, bad option, bad superblock on overlay, missing codepage or helper program, or other error.; home fs=overlayfs; /dev/fuse absent
findings.limitation: 磁盘 overlay upper 与 fuse-overlayfs 不可用;v1 rootfs 仅承诺 FULL_COPY(磁盘整树复制)与 TMPFS_COW(内存回写层)两条路径

findings.name: network
findings.evidence_command: unshare -Urn sh -c 'ip link add lsbxprobe0 type veth peer name lsbxprobe1 && ip link del lsbxprobe0'
findings.output_excerpt: sh: 1: ip: not found; netns 可建但仅 ['lo']; helpers=none
findings.limitation: 无 rootless 网络 helper(slirp4netns/pasta 均缺);veth 实验在 私有 netns 内执行(宿主零残留);v1 承诺 network=none(loopback only),出口网络属可选增强

findings.name: seccomp
findings.output_excerpt: Seccomp:	0; runc features rc=0, seccomp entry absent; 静态 runc 构建无 libseccomp(宿主无头文件)
findings.limitation: 内核支持 seccomp 但当前 v1 运行二进制未带过滤支持;不可宣称 seccomp 策略强制,直到以 libseccomp 重建并复测

findings.name: lsm
findings.output_excerpt: apparmor enabled=Y; securityfs/profiles 不可读 (ls: cannot access '/sys/kernel/security/apparmor': No such file or directory); getenforce=absent
findings.limitation: 宿主 AppArmor 激活于外层且不可由本层管理;不加载自定义 LSM 策略,v1 不以 LSM 为安全边界

findings.name: filesystem
findings.output_excerpt: ls: cannot access '/dev/fuse': No such file or directory; / fs type=overlayfs
findings.limitation: 无 /dev/fuse ⇒ fuse-overlayfs/fuse2fs 不可用;宿主根文件系统为 overlayfs(磁盘 overlay upper 受 EINVAL 约束)

findings.name: resource
findings.output_excerpt: Failed to connect to bus: $DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS and $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR not defined (consider using --machine=<user>@.host --user to connect to bus of other user); RLIMIT 参考: RESOURCE DESCRIPTION                  SOFT      HARD UNITS, RESOURCE DESCRIPTION                 SOFT    HARD UNITS
findings.limitation: 无 user.slice 委托;RLIMIT_* 仅是进程级护栏(且 RLIMIT_NPROC 按宿主 UID 计数,多沙箱共 UID 时不能当 per-sandbox 配额),禁止命名成 cgroup 硬限
